title: EU AI Act obligations for general-purpose AI models start to apply
summary: On 1 August 2025 the European Commission announced that the AI Act's obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models apply from 2 August 2025: providers must meet transparency and copyright obligations when placing a model on the EU market, and models already on the market before that date must comply by 2 August 2027. Providers of models trained with more than 10^25 FLOP, which present systemic risks, face additional obligations including notifying the Commission and ensuring the model's safety and security, and the Commission and Member States confirmed the GPAI Code of Practice as an adequate voluntary tool for demonstrating compliance.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17; page shows 'Publication 01 August 2025' (last update 4 August 2025). The 2 August 2025 and 2 August 2027 dates, the 10^25 FLOP systemic-risk threshold and the notification and safety-and-security duties are confirmed from the page body. The page does not mention agents; relevance rests on these being binding duties on the providers of the frontier models that deployed agents run on (survey 10.4).
